subject: GetYourGuide day tours from London that include Bath, grouped by what the day covers
method: Started from data/day-trips/gyg-inventory.json (destinations.Bath, 36 product ids). Opened 14 product pages in the browser at https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/activity/-t<id> and read the includes and excludes lists off the page, separating them by the checkmark and cross icons in the DOM rather than by reading order. Prices are the live sidebar from-price on the date checked, which on several products is higher than the cached SEO title and the widget figure.
headline: Of the 14 pages read, exactly two include an attraction admission with no conditional clause attached: 61147 (Stonehenge) and 593863 (Roman Baths). 525528, which starts in Bath rather than London, includes Stonehenge. Everything else either excludes admissions plainly or gates them behind a paid booking option.

groups.verdict: No credible London coach product goes to Bath and nowhere else. Recommend the train.
61147 is the pick: Stonehenge express entry genuinely included, best reviewed Bath product on the platform.
Every product read in this group gates entry behind a paid option. Nothing to recommend unconditionally.
593863 is the only product read whose includes list carries Roman Baths entry with no conditional clause. The two Click Tours products at GBP 102 are the conditional version of the same day.
No admissions included, but Avebury's stone circle and Lacock village are free to walk, so there is no hidden ticket unless you want Lacock Abbey.
Transport and driver only. No guided time in either city, 2 reviews.
The English Bus products are the honest ones: Stonehenge tickets are plainly excluded and sold by the driver-guide on the day, with the full price table printed on the product page.

groups.group: Starting in Bath rather than London
groups.verdict: For someone staying in Bath. Rabbie's 16-seater from Terrace Walk with Stonehenge entry included. Not in the London-departure inventory, so it was found by direct id lookup.

notChecked.note: 22 of the 36 Bath product ids were not opened on this pass. They are the thinly reviewed, the private and the duplicated-itinerary products, and the low-review Windsor-Stonehenge-Bath variants.

caveats: GetYourGuide from-prices move. Several products show a higher live sidebar price than the cached SEO title and than the inventory figure: 7319 and 977 at GBP 79 against GBP 71, 43772 at GBP 159 against GBP 143.
945 (5,821 reviews, the most-booked Bath product) was not reopened on this pass; its 'IF PURCHASED' inclusions line is carried over from the page read recorded in gyg-inventory.json.
Ratings and review counts drift daily; 61147 read 3,167 reviews against the 3,158 in the inventory.
